events.content:
Migration complete. The `pages/` directory is gone, everything now lives in `app/` as typed TypeScript, `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean, `next build` succeeds with the expected rendering modes (SSR for `/`, ISR for the blog pages, 10 prerendered post paths), and a production smoke test confirmed every page and API endpoint behaves as before.

How each Pages Router API was replaced:

| Before (pages/) | After (app/) |
|---|---|
| `_app.js` + `_document.js` | `app/layout.tsx` — root layout renders `<html>`/`<body>`, the `AppProvider`, header/nav/footer, imports `globals.css`; site description and favicon moved to the `metadata` export |
| `index.js` with `getServerSideProps` reading `req.headers` | `app/page.tsx` — async Server Component using `headers()` from `next/headers` (awaited, per Next 16) and `fetch(..., { cache: 'no-store' })` to stay per-request dynamic |
| `blog/index.js` with `getStaticProps` + `revalidate: 60` | `app/blog/page.tsx` with `export const revalidate = 60` and `fetch(..., { next: { revalidate: 60 } })` |
| `blog/[id].js` with `getStaticPaths` (`fallback: 'blocking'`), `getStaticProps` (`revalidate: 300`, `notFound: true`) | `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx` with `generateStaticParams` (first 10 posts), `export const revalidate = 300`, `dynamicParams = true` (the blocking-fallback equivalent), and `notFound()` from `next/navigation`; `router.isFallback` became `app/blog/[id]/loading.tsx` |
| `next/head` in every page | `metadata` exports, and `generateMetadata` for the dynamic post title/description/OpenGraph tags |
| `404.js` | `app/not-found.tsx` |
| `_error.js` with `getInitialProps` (removed in App Router) | `app/error.tsx` + `app/global-error.tsx` error boundaries with typed `error`/`reset` props |
| `api/posts/*.js` handlers with `req.method` branching | Route Handlers `app/api/posts/route.ts` (GET/POST) and `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` (GET/PUT/DELETE) using `NextResponse.json`; `params` is awaited as a Promise, request bodies read via `request.json()`, and 405 + `Allow` for unsupported methods is handled automatically |
| `useRouter` from `next/router` | `useRouter` from `next/navigation` in small client components (`NavButton`, `BackButton`), keeping the pages themselves Server Components |

Supporting changes: `components/AppProvider.js` became a typed `'use client'` component (`AppProvider.tsx`) since Context requires a Client Component, shared `Post`/`Comment` interfaces live in `lib/types.ts`, and the Next build auto-added `.next/dev/types/**/*.ts` to `tsconfig.json`'s include list.
